neighbours.label: verbs of saying, wanting or feeling in personal statements (say, want, feel, think)
fire: After all these years, I just want to take a minute to say thank you to my parents.
We would like to say a big thanks to everyone who came to the fair.
Honestly, my legs did not want to move after that long run.
I always feel a little nervous before speaking in front of the class.
Some neighbours think the new park is a waste of money.
Our coach has something to say about the referee's decision.
Most visitors felt that the museum was far too crowded.
Do you really want to know what happened at the party?
quiet: After all these years, I just want to take a minute to walk around my old school.
We would like to send a big box to everyone who came to the fair.
Honestly, my legs were very sore after that long run.
I always eat a little breakfast before speaking in front of the class.
Some neighbours visit the new park every single morning.
Our coach has a new whistle for the referee's decision.
Most visitors walked through the museum in an hour.
Do you really have the keys to the house after the party?
